ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white lobes bisected by a dark vertical median band. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated along the trailing edges and distal tips. Multiple small, isolated dark circular focal spots are mapped across the interior white regions, specifically a prominent cluster in the lower-central left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 40-45 degree angle and a depth roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the posterior boundary with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels, appearing most jagged on the inner portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edges that sweep upward into sharp, posteriorly-curved tips; leading edges exhibit a broad convex curve from the peduncle attachment.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters on the black distal tips, consistent with barnacle attachment points. Small dark circular pixel clusters (rosette-like) are visible on the white ventral surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, diagonally-oriented linear pixel disruptions visible on the upper-inner white region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notch patterns on the trailing edge of the right lobe that appear deeper than standard serration; visible white scarring on the extreme distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific dark 'island' spot located approximately halfway between the median notch and the left lobe tip.
